ayahs.textEn: When Allah’s ˹ultimate˺ help comes and the victory ˹over Mecca is achieved˺,

ayahs.textAr: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
ayahs.textEn: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way in crowds,

ayahs.textAr: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
ayahs.textEn: then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
